description: kennel is an open-source task list application with tasks, projects, and labels, plus a web dashboard. It lets apps and AI agents read and modify that task data over HTTP and MCP.
summary: kennel.work exposes two developer integration surfaces: a REST API at `https://kennel.work/api/v1` with OpenAPI at `https://kennel.work/openapi.json`, and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://kennel.work/mcp`; both accept kennel API keys, and both also support OAuth 2.1 bearer tokens.
